Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the weekly capacity, the load share that counts as overloaded, the coordinator hour cost, the crew rate and the hiring trigger.
Check Team: the owner planner, the coordinators and the freelance crew with weekly hours, pay and hour cost. Open tasks, overdue tasks, hours and free hours fill in by themselves.
Keep Events current: lead, status, guests and planning fee. Planned hours, hours logged, the fee per hour and the handover date fill in.
Create the tasks of a new event from Task Templates and Task Due Dates, then enter them on Tasks with an owner, a due date and an estimated time.
Log hours on Staff Hours the same day. They feed Weekly Capacity, Labour Cost by Event, Workload by Person and Productivity Summary.
Read Weekly Capacity every Monday: planned hours against the hours available, with leave taken off, and the load check.
Record every late or stuck task on Overdue and Blocked with the reason, the new due date and who helps.
Plan every event on Event Staffing Plan with a second coordinator and the crew, and book the crew on Freelance Crew Bookings.
Enter leave on Leave with who covers. Events Affected shows the events of that person in those days.
Use Training and Skills, Performance and Team Meetings to keep reviews, feedback and decisions with owners and dates.
Keep Payroll, Owner Pay and Hiring Plan up to date. Hiring Trigger and New Coordinator show when to hire and what it costs.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: capacity check, hours needed, fee yield, overload finder, task due dates, day staffing, overtime, hiring, new coordinator, crew cost, leave cover, clash check, payroll and a team size what-if grid.
Read Team and Capacity Dashboard and Charts every week: tasks, hours, load, labour cost, payroll and the fee per hour.
